services_subhead: From fresh interior walls to full exterior transformations, we handle every decorating project with attention to detail and professional finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We refresh living spaces with careful prep, quality paint, and immaculate finishes. Walls, ceilings, woodwork—we transform rooms to your exact specifications.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior with weather-resistant paints and sealants. We prepare surfaces properly for long-lasting colour and durability.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Add character and style with professional wallpapering, including feature walls and specialty finishes. Every pattern is hung straight and trimmed precisely.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, windows, and fitted furniture deserve expert finishing. We use top-quality paints and techniques for durable, professional results.

services.title: Textured Finishes & Coatings
services.desc: Create depth and character with Artex, render finishes, and specialist coatings. Perfect for feature walls or covering imperfections with style.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Refresh offices, shops, and business properties on schedule and within budget. We work flexibly to minimise disruption to your operations.

about_pullquote: I set up AJS to prove decorators can be honest, punctual, and deliver real quality.
about_para_1: AJS Decorating Services was founded on a simple principle: treat every customer's home as if it were our own. For over 15 years, we've built a reputation in Newcastle for meticulous prep work, superior paint application, and finishes that last. We've transformed hundreds of homes and commercial spaces, from period terraces to modern apartments.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we show up on time, protect their belongings, tidy as we go, and deliver exactly what we promise. We're not the cheapest—we're the ones who get it right the first time. References and a portfolio of recent work are always available on request.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About AJS

reviews.text: Needed our lounge redecorated before a family visit. Alan came round, gave us a sensible quote, and was here when he said he'd be. Work was brilliant—walls were perfect, no mess. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret K.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of our Victorian terrace done. The prep work was thorough, they were tidy, and the paint job has held up beautifully through the winter. Fair price and professional throughout.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Wallpapered our hallway and feature wall. Straight lines, no bubbles, corners are crisp. Called back in January to paint our bedroom—same quality every time. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Claire M.
